notes.title: The "Big" Update
notes.notes:
Everyone on the team has been pretty busy, so a small update that's mostly Quality of Life

- cant join in the locker room by pressing any button on the keyboard (game is focused on using controllers but if you really wanna play with keyboard just press zero)

-updated art in settings menu (doesn't look like default unity UI anymore)

-2 player splitscreen actually splits screen in 2 now

-killmarker fades out instead of just disappearing

-changed some backend so some things aren't frame dependent anymore

we also added some achievements, so have fun with earning those!

So this is it. The last ounce of development this game will get, we're a small team and we need to move on. To anyone who ever played this game or will play it. We genuinely thank you. We loved making this game and hope that it shows in every facet of this product. Stay Unnatural.

-Goopi Inc
